cases.name: Martine Bernard
cases.narrative: He shot her in the head. Then five days later on 6/9/2018, he traveled over to her parents’ home in order to kill her father, Roosevelt Bernard. Blanc would later tell officers that while his mother-in-law was showering, he followed Roosevelt into Martine’s old bedroom. After fatally shooting him in the back, officers said Blanc “then exited, locked and discarded the keys to the bedroom.” He left Martine's body in her apartment for a week. Authorities say that later on another night, Blanc dragged Martine Bernard’s body in a trash container and left it by the dumpster in an alleyway of the apartment complex. Blanc attempted to dismember her body to make it easier to dispose of, but he failed to remove any body parts.

cases.name: Heather Asendorf
cases.about:
Asendorf’s friend told the Sun Sentinel that she was staying at a hotel about a block from where her body was found. The friend also said that he last saw Asendorf on December 24, and that she was dancing at the Hollywood Beach Bandshell.

“She was a really sweet girl. Everybody really liked her. She did her own dance,” he said.

She was from Pennsylvania, but she was in Hollywood for a few weeks to visit friends in the area.
cases.narrative: On 12/26/2025, her body was found under a tarp on Hollywood Beach.
